note: ajax_quiz is a behaviour add-on with NO entities/question types/config/Drush. ajax_quiz_form_alter() targets the forms quiz_question_answering_form and quiz_report_form and, only when the current user has the 'access ajax quiz' permission, wraps them in #ajax-quiz-wrapper and attaches the ajax_quiz_navigate_quiz callback to navigation submit buttons; that callback advances the quiz via the quiz.session service. Its only config surface is the single permission 'access ajax quiz'. Medium/hard cases are grounded in a real user role holding that permission.

evals.prompt: What does the ajax_quiz submodule of Quiz do, and how does it hook into the quiz-taking flow?
evals.expected_output: It loads successive quiz questions in the same page via AJAX (no full reload). ajax_quiz_form_alter() wraps the quiz answering/report forms in an #ajax-quiz-wrapper and attaches the ajax_quiz_navigate_quiz #ajax callback to the navigation submit buttons, advancing the quiz via the quiz.session service.

evals.prompt: Which permission controls whether a user gets the AJAX quiz experience from the ajax_quiz module?
evals.expected_output: The 'access ajax quiz' permission. ajax_quiz_form_alter only adds the AJAX behaviour when the current user has 'access ajax quiz'; otherwise the standard non-AJAX flow is used.

evals.prompt: Which Quiz forms does ajax_quiz alter to add its AJAX behaviour?
evals.expected_output: It alters quiz_question_answering_form and quiz_report_form (adding #ajax to their navigation submit buttons for users with 'access ajax quiz').

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a user role with machine name 'ajax_quiz_role'. Inspect the live role and report which quiz-related permission it grants that enables AJAX quiz-taking.
evals.expected_output: The ajax_quiz_role role holds the 'access ajax quiz' permission (user.role.ajax_quiz_role), which enables the AJAX quiz-taking experience.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a role 'ajax_quiz_role'. Grant it the permission that lets its users take quizzes with the AJAX experience from the ajax_quiz module. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The ajax_quiz_role role is granted the 'access ajax quiz' permission (e.g. Role::load('ajax_quiz_role')->grantPermission('access ajax quiz')->save(), or drush role:perm:add ajax_quiz_role 'access ajax quiz').
